# AgentHive Inc

> AgentHive Inc (AGENTHIVEINCCOM LLC, Palm Coast, Florida) is a done-for-you AI operator for funded companies and 30–200 person teams that already pay for software. Main offers: the AI Ad Sprint ($297 one time, or $997/mo for 20 new ads), AI Concierge ($2,000/mo), and consulting at $75 / 30 min, $150 / hour, or a 10-hour pack at $1,250. Picks (https://agenthiveinc.com/picks/) is the one-page storefront for our Come and Take It gear and the tools and deals we recommend. Call +1 320-335-6186. IndexMe.lol is the honest IndexNow indexing desk at https://indexme.lol.

AgentHive Inc builds to your brand, runs it, and hands you the finished result. Public site: https://agenthiveinc.com. AgentHive Inc · Palm Coast, FL · firstdeploy.ai. Not agenthive.io (insurance) or agenthive.co. Distinct from other “AgentHive” names in insurance, OSS, or QpiAI.
